messages:
Nia: Quick sync — need to lock QBR scorecard + MDF allocation for cloud marketplace + HW partners before Friday. Sharing a consolidated sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/ABC123. Can each partner owner drop final asks and expected joint announcement dates?
Luca: Added our SI integration readiness check. For SI X we have ~3 weeks dev work, can be ready by May 12. I put notes in the 'SI readiness' tab.
Sam: Looked at the sheet — HW partner credits are over-requesting in tier 2. Can we standardize credit slabs per tier? Suggested slabs: Tier 1 = $150k, Tier 2 = $50k, Tier 3 = $10k (co-marketing + demo credits). Thoughts?
Priya: @Sam I like a slab approach but we should reserve a flex buffer for joint launches. Propose 10% of total MDF as launch reserve. Also we need to map credits to measurable KPIs (pipeline influenced, demo-to-deal).
Mark: For marketplace listing promos, cloud partner asked for $60k. That's close to Tier 2 slab. If we standardize, we should grandfather existing commitments for Q2.
PartnerOpsBot: Automated reminder: submit final MDF requests by 2026-04-10 17:00 PT. :spiral_calendar:
Nia: Agree with slab + 10% reserve. Action: Priya to draft KPI matrix, Sam to rebalance slab numbers, Mark to list committed exceptions. I'll consolidate and circulate before Friday. Who owns final QBR slide?
Priya: I'll own the QBR slide deck. Will need consolidated numbers by Thu noon.
Luca: One more thing — joint announcement cadence: recommend staggering hardware partner announcements to avoid overlap with cloud marketplace marketing windows. I added proposed dates on the 'announcements' tab.
Sam: @Luca can you flag any SI launches that require our infra upgrades? We might need Dedicated capacity reserved.
Luca: Yes — SI Y and SI Z need Dedicated for performance tests. Estimated commit: 8 GPUs for 3 weeks. Put that under 'dedicated requests' tab.
Mark: For PR/comms, partner PR wants 2-week embargo then joint blog. Coordinate with marketing. I'll loop in Elaine from comms after we finalize dates.
Priya: Giving myself an action: draft KPI matrix and sample slide, will share by Wed EOD.
Nia: Cool. Quick poll — thumbs up if you agree to slab + 10% reserve. :thumbsup: (reactions: Sam 👍, Priya 👍, Mark 👍)
PartnerOpsBot: Note: thread updated — 6 participants.
